name: Soil Reducer (v1.17.10)
body:
<!-- Soil Reducer (v1.17.10) -->

This is a quick release that postpones the Amsterdam fork on the Hoodi testnet, previously scheduled for Oct 26, 2026, 17:42:48 UTC. Hoodi node operators running v1.17.9 must upgrade before then. A new date will be set in a future release; other networks are unaffected.

Snap sync now switches to snap/2 automatically once Amsterdam is active. Use `--snap.v2=false` or `--snap.v2=true` to force a protocol.

## Changes

- Cancel the Amsterdam activation on Hoodi (#36001)
- Use snap/2 automatically once Amsterdam is active (#35989)
- Optimize DUP/SWAP dispatch in the interpreter (#35959)

For a full rundown of the changes please consult the Geth [1.17.10](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/milestone/207?closed=1) release milestone.

---

As with all our previous releases, you can find the:

- Pre-built binaries for all platforms on our [downloads page](https://geth.ethereum.org/downloads/)
- Docker images published under [`ethereum/client-go`](https://hub.docker.com/r/ethereum/client-go) (use "stable" tag)
- Ubuntu packages in our [Launchpad PPA repository](https://launchpad.net/~ethereum/+archive/ubuntu/ethereum)
- macOS packages in our [Homebrew Tap repository](https://github.com/ethereum/homebrew-ethereum)

name: Universal Semiconductor (v1.17.9)
body:
This release enables the Amsterdam fork 🦩 on the Hoodi testnet at block timestamp **1793036568 (Mon, 26 Oct 2026 17:42:48 UTC)**.

It also contains changes to the EVM to improve the performance significantly.

This release is recommended for all users running their nodes on the Hoodi testnet.

## Geth

- Blsync now supports the Gloas beacon chain fork and had some bug fixes (#35956, #35385, #35957)
- When running an archive node, you can now configure the transaction index history using `--history.transactions` flag. (#35907)

## Core

- Amsterdam fork is set to activate at block timestamp 1793036568. (#35974)
- EVM interpreter opcode dispatching became 16% faster due to a new inlined switch implementation. (#35638)
- Several fixes for database corruption on power failure (#35939, #35936)
- Bug fix in trie database related to concurrent state reading (#35978)
- RPC call concurrent with block processing could result in BAL corruption. (#35905)
- State history committing is moved to the background, making `newPayload` 2% faster. (#35949)
- Key-value database settings changed for improved write performance (#35691)
- Fixed log index under history pruning beyond the checkpoint (#35875)

## Networking 

- Fixed snap/2 restart issue by checking for pivot block reorg in the header chain (#35930, #35982)
- Added metrics to discovery listeners (#35673)
- Fixed mempool corruption with tip below base fee (#35988)

## RPC

- `eth_simulateV1` spec compliance fixes (#35841, #35842, #35953)
- `eth_call` and similar methods will reject fields which are not aligned with forks 
- `eth_fillTransaction` always chooses AccessList transaction when `accessList` is provided by user. (#35969)
- `eth_newFilter` now accepts `earliest` in `toBlock`. (#35933)
- `eth_sendTransaction` rejects invalid `yParity` value in 7702 transactions. (#35761)
- In `debug_traceTransaction`, `debug_traceCall`, omit storage on halted SLOAD/SSTORE steps. (#35961)
- Pending block access was fixed on the Amsterdam fork transition block. (#35968)
- Historical RPC calls will reject transaction features which have not yet activated. (#35914, #35928)

---

For a full rundown of the changes please consult the Geth [1.17.9](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/milestone/206?closed=1) release milestone.

As with all our previous releases, you can find the:

- Pre-built binaries for all platforms on our [downloads page](https://geth.ethereum.org/downloads/).
- Docker images published under [`ethereum/client-go`](https://hub.docker.com/r/ethereum/client-go) (use "stable" tag).
- Ubuntu packages in our [Launchpad PPA repository](https://launchpad.net/~ethereum/+archive/ubuntu/ethereum).
- macOS packages in our [Homebrew Tap repository](https://github.com/ethereum/homebrew-ethereum).

name: Protein Sludge Pack (v1.17.8)
body:
This is a security-focused release, fixing several DoS risk issues ❤️‍🩹 . Note most of the the fixes related to bugs which only become possible after the activation of the Amsterdam fork. There are also some general correctness improvements.

This release is recommended for all users.

## All Changes

### Security

- In the eth and snap p2p protocol handler, DoS resistance has been improved for multiple packet handlers (#35862, #35883, #35859, #35857, #35904, #35856)
- JUMPDEST analysis caching has been hardened for attack cases after Amsterdam fork (#35881)
- The IP address predictor now requires IP verification before accepting statements (#35861)
- A post-Amsterdam DoS vector related to BAL accounts is resolved (#35865)
- A rogue STUN server could crash the node with an invalid response (#35863)

### RPC

- `eth_createAccessList` now works when the sender account has no balance (#35397)
- `eth_simulateV1` has been fixed to correctly report ETH transfer logs post-Amsterdam (#35617)
- `eth_simulateV1` virtual blocks are now aligned with the Amsterdam spec (#35668)
- `eth_capabilities` reports the availability of receipts bounded by the transaction hash index (#35878)
- For `eth_call` and related operations, the transaction gas limit is no longer applied (after Amsterdam fork) (#35845)
- A post-Amsterdam crash in journaled live tracers core/tracing: handle creator nonce change without an open frame (#35896)
- An edge case in processing beacon chain head updates after unclean shutdown is resolved (#35804)
- abigen will now use sequential nonces when deploying library dependencies of a contract (#35888)

### Core Library

- The hard-coded Hoodi testnet beacon chain genesis time was incorrect (#35876)
- blsync could get stuck if the server was unresponsive or overloaded (#35872)

### P2P

- A correctness issue in the EIP-8070 Sparse Blobpool (Amsterdam fork) implementation is fixed (#35860)
- The dial scheduler now handles IPv4 <> IPv6 transitions for DNS-resolved static nodes (#35880)

### Build

- The PPA now publishes for Ubuntu 26.04 "Resolute Raccoon" (#35854)

---

For a full rundown of the changes please consult the Geth [1.17.8](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/milestone/205?closed=1) release milestone.

As with all our previous releases, you can find the:

- Pre-built binaries for all platforms on our [downloads page](https://geth.ethereum.org/downloads/).
- Docker images published under [`ethereum/client-go`](https://hub.docker.com/r/ethereum/client-go) (use "stable" tag).
- Ubuntu packages in our [Launchpad PPA repository](https://launchpad.net/~ethereum/+archive/ubuntu/ethereum).
- macOS packages in our [Homebrew Tap repository](https://github.com/ethereum/homebrew-ethereum).
